description: This file defines an enum ToolResultTextFormatter with static methods for formatting and rendering JSON-like text, particularly for error and status messages, including special handling for nodes and pairing requests.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats input text based on whether it looks like JSON and the provided tool name.

methods.name: looksLikeJSON
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be JSON based on its first character.

methods.name: renderJSON
methods.description: Renders JSON data into a string, handling dictionaries and arrays.

methods.name: renderDictionary
methods.description: Renders a dictionary as a status or error message, with special handling for nodes.

methods.name: renderNodesSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for a list of nodes, including details like connection status and platform.

methods.name: pairingDetail
methods.description: Determines if a node requires pairing based on its properties.

methods.name: firstString
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty string value for a list of keys in a dictionary.

methods.name: sanitizeError
methods.description: Cleans up error message strings for display.
